subject: ela
cluster: Research to build and present knowledge
intro: Pick the best note, paraphrase, or source idea.

items.prompt:
Putting a fact into your own words is called:
A) paraphrasing
B) printing
C) copying

Shortening information to its key points is:
A) summarizing
B) expanding
C) erasing

steps: Brief key points. Key is A.

items.prompt:
A list of where your facts came from is a list of:
A) sources
B) titles
C) colors

Which is a good PARAPHRASE of 'Owls are nocturnal'?
A) Owls are nocturnal.
B) Owls are active at night.
C) Owls are birds.
items.answer: B) Owls are active at night.

steps: Own words, same meaning. Key is B.
solution.answer: B) Owls are active at night.

items.prompt:
Why should a researcher PROVIDE a list of sources?
A) to credit authors and show where facts came from
B) to make the report heavier
C) to hide the facts
items.answer: A) to credit authors and show where facts came from

steps: Credit and tracking. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) to credit authors and show where facts came from

items.prompt:
Copying another writer's exact words and calling them your own is:
A) plagiarism
B) paraphrasing
C) summarizing

steps: Avoid it; cite instead. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Read.

The blue whale is the largest animal ever known, even bigger than the biggest dinosaurs.

The BEST paraphrase is:
A) The blue whale is the biggest animal to ever exist, larger than any dinosaur.
B) The blue whale is the largest animal ever known, even bigger than the biggest dinosaurs.
C) Whales are big.
items.answer: A) The blue whale is the biggest animal to ever exist, larger than any dinosaur.

steps: Own words, keeps meaning. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) The blue whale is the biggest animal to ever exist, larger than any dinosaur.

items.prompt:
You take notes from three websites and two books for a report. For your finished work, you should:
A) list all five sources
B) list only one
C) list none

steps: List every source used. Key is A.
